protocol.actuator_targets: all zero (position targets, not zero applied force)
protocol.ground: model floor z=0; no environmental randomization
protocol.com: neutral-pose body-mass weighted axial projection; tail exclusion is mathematical
protocol.bilateral_gates: both sides and both joint/actuator ranges must pass
protocol.claim: engineering morphology audit; not walking or kinematic validation

corrections_and_limits: The model has 32 hinge joints, not the 26 asserted in parts of the supplied documents.
Fuller Table1 femur/tibia is 1.54/1.51=1.0199, not 0.98. The requested 0.90–1.06 pass band is retained explicitly.
Fuller Table1 tibia SEM is 0.02 cm, not the 0.04 cm transcribed in the supplied scorecard.
Interorbital distance is approximated by the inner spherical-eye gap, not center-to-center separation.
The source limb total includes fourth toe. MJCF ankle-to-digit geometry is a proxy, not a measured metatarsal segment.
Static zero-control heights are engineering gates using walking reference values; they do not establish dynamic posture validity.
A root spawn-height edit alone cannot set the eventual mechanically settled hip height.
Gate tolerances are engineering choices. Passing them is not a statistical claim about individual animals.
Tail CoM exclusion holds all remaining segments in the same neutral pose and is not an autotomy behavior experiment.

gates.notes: Engineering population choice near lab cohorts, not one published individual or a mean of pooled animals.

gates.label: Tail mass fraction

gates.notes: Transcribed from supplied research; anatomical partition remains approximate.

gates.label: Tail chain / SVL
gates.source: Rawat et al. (2019), Reptiles & Amphibians 26(1):58–61, Table 1, doi:10.17161/randa.v26i1.14342
gates.notes: 87 mm / 119 mm from the ONE intact-tail specimen; second specimen had a regenerated tail. Transferred to lab-cohort body size.

gates.label: Intact CoM behind nose / SVL
gates.source: Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916
gates.notes: Supplied-source target. Compare axial projection in neutral pose; this is not full walking CoM validation.

gates.label: Tail-excluded CoM / SVL
gates.source: Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916
gates.notes: Supplied-source target after complete tail loss. Audit excludes tail masses in the SAME pose; it does not simulate surgery or compensation.

gates.label: Settled hip height / SVL
gates.source: Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916
gates.notes: Walking measurement used as a static neutral-control engineering gate. Settled stance is not the same experimental protocol.

gates.label: Settled shoulder height / SVL
gates.source: Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916; CODEX_PROMPT.md (user build brief, 2026-09-05)
gates.notes: Build target; the supplied paper table rounds shoulder height to 0.11 SVL. Static neutral-control proxy for walking height.

gates.label: Shoulder / hip height
gates.source: Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916

gates.label: Femur / tibia length
gates.source: Fuller, Higham & Clark (2011), Zoology 114:104–112, Table 1, doi:10.1016/j.zool.2010.11.003
gates.notes: Correct femur/tibia ratio is 1.0199, not 0.98. The latter reverses the ratio; requested pass band is retained separately.

gates.label: Hindlimb chain / SVL
gates.source: Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916; Fuller, Higham & Clark (2011), Zoology 114:104–112, Table 1, doi:10.1016/j.zool.2010.11.003
gates.notes: Cross-study ratio 0.15/0.36. Fuller absolute total/SVL is 4.41/10.65=0.414. Total limb includes fourth toe; current model digit is an engineering proxy.

gates.label: Hip pro/retraction range
gates.source: Jagnandan & Higham (2017), Sci Rep 7:10865, doi:10.1038/s41598-017-11484-7; CODEX_PROMPT.md (user build brief, 2026-09-05)
gates.notes: Engineering range allowance for observed 82.57-degree excursion, NOT a cadaveric anatomical ROM. Both joint limits and position actuator ranges must permit it.

gates.label: Hip rotation range
gates.source: Arnold et al. (2014), Iguana proxy as cited in docs/research/gecko_scorecard.md
gates.notes: Cross-species engineering ceiling from supplied research, not leopard-gecko ROM. Primary source not independently rechecked.

gates.label: Skin head width / SVL
gates.source: Rawat et al. (2019), Reptiles & Amphibians 26(1):58–61, Table 1, doi:10.17161/randa.v26i1.14342
gates.notes: 22/119=0.185 for specimen1; specimen2 21/109=0.193. Gate measures skin geometry excluding protruding eye spheres; collision width is reported separately.

gates.label: Inner-eye gap
gates.source: Rawat et al. (2019), Reptiles & Amphibians 26(1):58–61, Table 1, doi:10.17161/randa.v26i1.14342
gates.notes: Both specimens measured 10 mm between eyes. Model uses shortest inner gap between visual spherical eyes, not center separation; that landmark mapping remains an engineering approximation.
